messages:
maddie: quick heads-up — my docs PR #5321 failed the preview CI. markdownlint + linkcheck + vale all complained. I pushed a tiny content change, but CI still failing. pasted snippet below.

ryan: can you paste the failing lines / log?

maddie: sure — linkcheck error: 1 broken link. vale: PassiveVoice and HeadingHaveCapitalization. markdownlint: line-length and MD022 (headings).

maddie: ```
Linkcheck: ERROR Broken link: /guides/sdk/python -> 404
Vale: PassiveVoice: "is used" in docs/architecture/serving.md:42
Markdownlint: MD022: multiple top level headings in docs/migrations.md:1
```

ryan: ah — that /guides/sdk/python route moved in the site move to /guides/sdk/py last week. will update the link.

sasha: I can take the markdownlint and header cleanup later today if you want.

maddie: thanks. updated the link to the new path in a small commit and shortened the long paragraph to satisfy line-length. pushed -> branch: docs/fix-5321-linkline

ci-bot: docs-preview: queued for run on branch docs/fix-5321-linkline

docs-bot: linkcheck: still failing — reports 1 broken link: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/guides/sdk/py returns 200 but /guides/sdk/py (relative) 404 in preview build.

olivia: heads-up — the preview environment expects absolute docs host for cross-repo moved pages. we added redirects on prod but preview build doesn't include redirects. use absolute docs URL (https://docs.redwood-inference.com/...).

maddie: switched to absolute URL and fixed heading case and removed extra H1 in migrations file. ran `vale --config .vale.ini` locally and fixed PassiveVoice lines. pushed again.

ryan: lgtm, I'll watch CI. if green I can merge and tag the release branch.

ci-bot: docs-preview: running (linkcheck -> markdownlint -> vale)

ci-bot: docs-preview: markdownlint passed

ci-bot: docs-preview: vale passed

ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck passed

ci-bot: docs-preview: SUCCESS — all checks passed on branch docs/fix-5321-linkline

maddie: thanks all! @ryan please merge when you have a moment. :thumbsup:

ryan: merging now. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.

sasha: nice, good catch on the redirect behavior — I'll add a short note to the docs dev guide about absolute vs relative links in preview.
